Alice Nguyen: Heads-up — Celestia Cloud just locked a 30m cohost slot at Cloud Summit on May 15. Need final demo plan, speaker list, and a swag manifest by EOD next Tue.
Mateo Rivera: Nice. Thinking 12m demo + 10m live Q&A + 8m panel? Or compress to 25m total to fit schedule constraints.
Priya Patel: I can lead the demo, Jamal can be backup for hardware failures. We should show both low-latency on EdgeForge hardware and a hosted fallback path.
Jamal Brooks: EdgeForge confirmed they'll ship a dev kit. Customs might add ~7 days. Need warehouse address + contact. Also they asked about booth power: they want to reserve 600W for the demo rigs.
Clara Li: Swag ask from marketing: 150 stickers, 75 hoodies (mostly L/XL), 50 USB-C cables, 20 EdgeForge dongles (partner-provided). Shipping cutoff May 1.
Alice Nguyen: Run-of-show draft — can we agree?
Alice Nguyen: ```
12:00 — intro (2m)
12:02 — partner remarks (3m)
12:05 — live demo (12m)
12:17 — live Q&A (8m)
12:25 — CTA + close (5m)
```
Mateo Rivera: Looks good, but if we need to compress, drop partner remarks to 2m and demo to 10m.
Priya Patel: Fallback plan: primary = EdgeForge local infer; fallback = redwood-slim-v1 hosted (auto-route). Healthcheck ping every 30s to decide route. Health endpoint: https://internal.redwood-infra/health/edgeforge-demo
Mateo Rivera: Can we pre-warm model cache on EdgeForge? Boot time could add 30s if idle. Suggest a 5-min warmup script run before session.
Jamal Brooks: I'll handle warmup + bring spare unit. Packaging list: dev kit, spare NVMe image, power brick, HDMI adapter, signage.
Clara Li: Shipping labels printed 2024-04-25 to BlueLine courier. I'll DM tracking and customs docs to Jamal.
sasha-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.company/ev/5f2b — attendees: Alice Nguyen, Mateo Rivera, Priya Patel, Jamal Brooks, Clara Li. Reminder set 48h and 2h before.
Alice Nguyen: Marketing wants a short demo script + 2 screenshots for the event listing by Friday. Can someone capture 2 clean screenshots after the warmup run?
Priya Patel: I'll capture screenshots and drop them in the drive: https://drive.redwood/integration/celestia-demo
Mateo Rivera: Quick checklist for final sign-off:
- confirm EdgeForge ship + eta (Jamal)
- swag manifest + sizes (Clara)
- run-of-show final (Alice)
- fallback route tested (Priya)
- live captions + AV check (ops)
I'll compile into a single runbook tomorrow AM.
Jamal Brooks: On it. I'll also share the EdgeForge contact email for customs clearance in DM.
Clara Li: Noted — will adjust hoodie quantities if customs blocks part of the shipment.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks team. Let's reconvene Mon 10am PT for final preflight. :thumbsup:
